Dahiya also expressed his desire to have veteran pacer Ishant Sharma as a red-ball mentor. The Ranji Trophy match between Delhi and Services ended in a draw, with Delhi walking away with three points after taking the first-innings lead.

Meet Sia Domkundwar, 16, whose burn survivors' guide reaches 10 hospitals
description: Sia Domkundwar, a 16-year-old from Pune, developed The Glow Guide to assist burn and acid attack survivors. The resource includes information on everyday self-care and personal care topics. Conversations with survivors informed the guide's approach to address individual needs and experiences. The Glow Guide is now being shared through the Chhanv Foundation in hospitals across India. Sia's project highlights the importance of practical support post-medical treatment for survivors.

description: India secured a silver medal in the team event at the ISSF World Championships held in Doha. However, Manu Bhaker and Suruchi Inder Singh failed to earn individual medals or Olympic quotas. Manu finished fifth while Suruchi placed sixth in the women's 10m air pistol final. Their individual performances disappointed the Indian team as they aimed for Olympic qualification.

description: Cristiano Ronaldo's international career spanned over two decades and was filled with remarkable achievements and controversies. He experienced public fallouts with coaches and significant incidents during his time in various clubs. Major controversies included a tax fraud case and an explosive interview leading to his Manchester United exit. Additionally, accusations of sexual assault and a red card incident involving Wayne Rooney further shaped his career.

title: ‘Baseless allegation’: CJP leaders challenge Jitendra to prove foreign funding claims
description: CJP activist Saurav Das rebuffed Union minister Jitendra Singh's allegations regarding foreign funding for their movement. Das demanded the provision of evidence to justify the claims being made against them. Ashutosh Ranka also challenged Singh, questioning the legitimacy of government negotiations with CJP if foreign funding was involved. The three CJP leaders were questioned for four hours by the Delhi Police Crime Branch regarding a recent protest.

title: Airbnb's new guest rule angers hosts; some threaten boycott, others raise fees
description: Airbnb has introduced a new policy that limits cleaning tasks expected from guests during their stay. Many hosts are unhappy and are considering actions including a booking blackout on the policy's effective date. While guests generally support the change, some hosts express discontent on social media platforms like Reddit. Airbnb's new rules aim to enhance guest experience by reducing their cleaning responsibilities.

title: Israel’s deadlock: Bibi in a bind, but what changes for India, Iran & Gaza?
description: Netanyahu's Likud party secured the most seats in the Knesset election but lacks the ability to form a government. Gadi Eisenkot, leading the opposition, has gained support from parties holding a majority of the seats. The Arab parties' strong voter turnout complicates coalition-building efforts for both sides. President Isaac Herzog faces challenges in selecting a candidate to build a coalition successfully.

title: UK’s Burnham won’t invite Putin to G20 summit next year; he skips them anyway
description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham confirmed that Vladimir Putin would not be invited to the 2027 G20 summit. This comes amid the intensified Russia-Ukraine war. However, the US has invited Putin to this year's G20, which has drawn criticism from European leaders. Russia continues to attend G20 meetings, though Putin doesn't attend in person.

title: Vermont CEO's 900-foot private runway sparks neighbour's $300,000 legal fight
Umar Khalid and Sharjeel Imam challenge HC's bail refusal in Supreme Court
description: Umar Khalid and Sharjeel Imam have filed for bail in the Supreme Court concerning the Delhi riots case. They contend that the prosecution has failed to call any witnesses during their extensive period of detention. The activists pointed out the looming deadline for submitting new bail applications as established by the Supreme Court.

title: US midterm: Democrats got it right, but what next?
Drones carrying drones: Turkey turns Bayraktar TB2 into flying weapons carrier
description: In an innovative leap in drone technology, Turkey's Bayraktar TB2 is being engineered as a launch platform for smaller kamikaze drones. Recently, it showcased its capabilities by successfully deploying Skydagger FPV drones onto targets. This integration not only enhances the operational range of these attack drones but also allows the TB2 to act as a communications hub, potentially redefining strategic warfare through coordinated aerial strikes from a single unit.

title: Cristiano Ronaldo retires: 10 record-breaking numbers from his 23-year career
description: Cristiano Ronaldo has officially retired from international football after an extraordinary 23-year career with Portugal. Leaving behind 234 appearances, a record 146 goals, six World Cup campaigns and three major international trophies, the 41-year-old ends his national-team journey as one of football’s greatest icons. His departure marks the end of an era, with records that may stand for generations.

title: Trump effect: US-based Indian techies are returning, but to what?
description: Techies returning from the US are getting into a wide range of tech and techno-functional roles across the board. Employers in India are also increasingly looking for specialised skills rather than treating international work experience as an advantage in itself. So, the important question then is: what are these techies returning to? Are there enough roles to absorb their talent? And, what about the salary levels?

title: Govt tweaks immigration rules: What changes for Indians travelling to Nepal, Bhutan
Footballer's death: Goalkeeper Owono left out of Equatorial Guinea’s AFCON squad
description: Equatorial Guinea goalkeeper Jesus Owono has been excluded from the AFCON qualifiers following the death of Jesus de Miguel. De Miguel passed away after a collision with Owono during a match, leaving many in mourning. Owono expressed deep sorrow and struggles to process the tragedy he experienced. He has faced online abuse, leading him to deactivate his social media account.

title: Michigan neighbours' $2,000 tree dispute ends as court blocks fresh lawsuit
description: Two Michigan neighbours agreed to pay $2,000 each to remove trees that threatened a barn, but the work never happened. When Seth Merle failed to return Richard Hagopian's money, the dispute reached court. Merle later filed another lawsuit over the same trees, arguing they remained dangerous. The Michigan Court of Appeals dismissed his case, ruling that the issue had already been decided.

title: Cristiano Ronaldo bids emotional farewell to national team: Read full speech
description: Cristiano Ronaldo has officially retired from international duty with Portugal after 23 years and six World Cups. He announced his retirement through an emotional video message to the Portuguese people, marking the end of his national career. Ronaldo holds a record of 146 international goals and significant victories, including Euro 2016 and the UEFA Nations League title.

title: Bombay HC cancels Sachin Waze's bail in Antilia bomb scare case
description: The Bombay High Court has overturned the bail originally granted to Sachin Waze regarding the serious Antilia bomb scare incident. This move came after the National Investigation Agency appealed against the previous bail decision. Waze, arrested in March 2021, remains in custody as the court highlights explosive elements and security threats, raising crucial legal and investigative discussions surrounding the case.

title: 'Losing gambler energy': Iran speaker mocks Vance's midterm assessment
Bombay HC shields Ananya Panday; platforms must erase AI images
description: The Bombay High Court has ordered the takedown of objectionable content violating Ananya Panday’s privacy, after she alleged businesses used her photos and AI-generated content without consent. Justice Madhav Jamdar cited her privacy and dignity rights. Meanwhile, the Delhi High Court gave Kriti Sanon limited relief, excluding news, parody and fan content.

title: US issues Forever stamp celebrating Diwali, features Rangoli created by Indian artist
description: In a vibrant tribute to Diwali, USPS has launched a new Forever stamp showcasing a stunning rangoli design by Sangita Bhutada. The unveiling occurred at the Embassy of India in Washington DC on October 21, marking the second issuance of a Diwali stamp since 2016. Crafted over eight to ten days with colored sand, this stamp edition comprises 20 million copies for collectors and enthusiasts alike.

title: The push for low-cost standoff weapons: Why air forces are turning to glide bombs
description: The US Air Force is investigating new glide bomb technologies to lower costs associated with missile-led campaigns. Current operations in prolonged conflicts have highlighted the expense of missile usage. The US military is also pursuing powered missile variants to enhance strike capabilities in various scenarios. India is developing similar glide bomb technologies aimed at increasing precision and operational range for its forces.

title: Hardeep Singh Puri elected unopposed to Rajya Sabha from Madhya Pradesh
description: Hardeep Singh Puri was elected unopposed to the Rajya Sabha from Madhya Pradesh after other candidates failed to qualify. The nominations of Rajkumar Lohani and Kante Sayanna were rejected for not meeting necessary requirements. Puri's election follows the resignation of Union minister of state L Murugan in mid-October. Hemant Khandelwal, among other officials, was present when Puri collected his election certificate.

title: Mid-air mayhem: Multiple flights in Europe diverted due to bomb threats
Cristiano Ronaldo announces retirement from international football
description: Cristiano Ronaldo announces his retirement from the Portuguese national team, expressing his intent to relinquish the cherished number 7 jersey following the November international fixtures. With an extraordinary record of 234 caps and 146 goals, he leaves behind a legacy as the all-time leading goal-scorer and appearance maker, concluding a remarkable era in international football.

title: Jeff Bezos' ex-wife $30 mn donation gets 10 yr affordable housing plan in Bay Area
description: Housing Trust Silicon Valley has unveiled an ambitious 10-year initiative aimed at improving affordable housing in the Bay Area. With a generous $30 million backing from MacKenzie Scott, this plan seeks to bolster homeownership initiatives and forge stronger alliances with policy advocacy. The focus is on maximizing current funding and attracting new resources to create and maintain affordable housing for the community over the next decade.

title: Trump's midterm setback may ease tariff pressure on India: Report
description: The outcome of the 2026 midterm elections could significantly boost India's leverage in trade negotiations with the US. With Democrats gaining power, Trump's capacity to enforce harsh tariffs is constrained, alleviating pressure on India. This shift allows India to pursue trade agreements more strategically and carefully, potentially resulting in better deals. Furthermore, new legal constraints on Trump limit his tariff imposition options, enhancing India's prospects in upcoming trade discussions.

title: ‘If death is my destiny’: Sheikh Hasina firm on returning to Bangladesh in December
description: Sheikh Hasina has confirmed her intention to return to Bangladesh, despite facing a death sentence. The former Prime Minister is aware of the risks associated with her return, including potential arrest or worse. Hasina's Awami League party has been banned, resulting in widespread political repression and violence against its members. She expressed concerns over the rising influence of extremist groups in the current political climate.

title: $23bn Trump-class battleship faces political storm as Democrats capture Congress
description: Democrats gained control of Congress after winning the 2026 midterm elections, which may impact Trump's battleship program. The Trump-class battleship faces criticism for its high costs and military relevance. Critics argue that investing in expensive warships could hinder the Navy's capability to maintain a larger fleet. The first battleship, USS Defiant, is projected to cost around $23 billion and be operational by 2036.

title: US midterm fallout: Trump's India envoy Sergio Gor may replace Marco Rubio - report
Does Democrat-held Congress mean end of US immigration, visa chaos? Not exactly
description: As Democrats gain control of both chambers of Congress, they are poised to scrutinize immigration policies more closely. However, the enduring executive powers from the Trump era pose challenges for immediate reforms. Policy shifts will likely be dictated by court decisions instead of congressional mandates due to the presidential veto power.

title: Jantar Mantar violence: SC gives panel 1 month to file report, flags lack of complaints
Trump's Midas curse: Why his golden picks turned blue in US midterms 2026
description: Donald Trump's endorsement of numerous candidates in the 2026 midterms proved less effective than anticipated, leading to notable electoral disappointments. Democrats triumphed in Senate and House elections, gaining ground in areas that were once Republican strongholds. The performance of Trump's endorsed candidates reflected a troubling disconnect with voters. Furthermore, Democratic success extended to gubernatorial elections and state legislatures, thereby underscoring an evolving political landscape laden with challenges for the GOP.

title: Guitar mistaken for pillion, turban for bare head: When AI traffic cameras get it wrong
description: AI-powered traffic cameras are increasingly being utilized in India for automated enforcement of traffic rules. However, the technology faces significant challenges resulting in numerous erroneous challans issued to motorists. Incidents include misidentification of objects, such as guitars and turbans, as violations leading to fines. Complaints regarding the accuracy of the system have surged, highlighting accountability issues. As technology evolves, ensuring accuracy is crucial in minimizing errors encountered by drivers.

title: Tata Sons chair Chandrasekaran meets Italy PM Meloni after Iveco takeover
description: N Chandrasekaran, the chairman of Tata Sons, recently engaged in discussions with Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni in Rome. Their talks revolved around Tata Motors' strategic acquisition of a controlling interest in Iveco Group. This move aims to enhance Tata Motors' global footprint and refine their market approach, with integration efforts already active as they look to solidify their international operations.

title: 'Contemplating to appoint a committee': Centre to SC on UGC's equity rules
EC announces electoral roll revision in 6 states, UTs; final rolls on Jan 21
'Why is this a special case?' Judge accused in son's deadly car crash gets bail
description: In a significant decision, the Kerala High Court has approved anticipatory bail for an additional sessions judge linked to a fatal accident that occurred on October 25. This tragic event resulted in the death of a 54-year-old scooterist, with the judge's young son reportedly at the wheel of a Mercedes-Benz involved in the incident.

title: Smoking, bike rally, songs greet man accused of murdering 16-year-old boy
description: Man Singh alias Betu Singraul, accused of murdering a 16-year-old boy, was recently released on bail. Following his release, he was welcomed with garlands outside the jail and took part in a bike rally. A viral video showed him participating while smoking a cigarette atop a vehicle during the procession. Authorities are now questioning possible violations of traffic rules and public safety during the event.

title: Sensex settles over 2,000 points higher, investors end Rs 8 lakh cr richer: Top reasons for rally
description: Dalal Street witnessed a major surge as Sensex soared over 1,600 points and Nifty50 gained 2%. This rise in the market was supported by a decline in crude oil prices and returning foreign investor interest. The US midterm election results also contributed positively to market sentiment globally. Broader market indices and banking stocks joined in the rally, reflecting widespread investor confidence.

title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes help 60 young women find their dream dresses
description: In 2024, Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes' KC Current partnered with Nuuly and United Way of Greater Kansas City to donate nearly 100 designer dresses to local young women. The initiative welcomed 60 members of the Boys & Girls Clubs of Greater Kansas City, offering them outfits for special occasions. Players Hailie Mace, Gabrielle Robinson and Nichelle Prince also joined the event, which focused on confidence and self-expression.

title: Ollie Watkins' wife Ellie returns to UK with kids amid Saudi security concerns
description: Ollie Watkins’ wife, Ellie, has returned to the UK with their two children months after his reported £50 million move from Aston Villa to Al-Hilal. Citing security concerns and regional conflict in Saudi Arabia, she said the family would stay in Britain until conditions improve. Watkins, meanwhile, continues his career in Riyadh, having recorded six goals and five assists in 10 appearances.
